summary: Iteration 11: tested preferences, application tracker (jobs+programs), AI cover letters (real Claude), closing-soon digest (real Resend email for preview + cron idempotency), content/credibility fixes, account deletion, and frontend dashboard/resume/jobs/landing/footer/privacy/register/program detail + mobile overflow. All 13 backend tests pass; all requested frontend checks pass.

minor.issue: Users with undeliverable addresses (e.g. admin@halifaxyouth.ca) are counted as 'failed' every run and retried daily forever (no digest_log entry on failure). Consider marking undeliverable recipients or auto-disabling reminders after hard bounces.

issues: 'Closes this week' badge (closing-badge-{id}) renders as pale pink with light text — low contrast compared to the solid red badge on /jobs; consider solid #FF3B30 bg with white text

action_items: (Optional) Handle permanently-undeliverable recipients in cron digest
(Optional) Improve contrast of dashboard closing-soon badge
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1074 lines — split into routers (auth, saved, resumes/ai, cover_letters, digest).
Duplicate LLM boilerplate (import + key check + LlmChat) in ai_assist, ai_summary, generate_cover_letter — extract helper.
Duplicate closing-soon job filtering in run_closing_soon_digest and send_my_digest_now — extract helper.
/me/closing-soon-digest/preview has no rate limit — a user can spam their own inbox / burn email credits.
StatusIn.status could be a Literal type for Pydantic validation instead of manual check (works fine as is: 400).
